summary:
Full investigation covering two topics:
1. Why the googlecloudtools.datacloud_telemetry plugin keeps reinstalling itself (cloud sync re-injection bug) with three permanent fix options
2. Complete benchmark reality check on OX Alpha — actual DeepSWE scores (63% on full 113-task benchmark vs the cherry-picked 80% from 10 tasks), comparison tables against Opus/GPT-5.6/Fable, the model's likely identity as Zhipu AI GLM-5.3, data privacy warnings, and a breakdown of why Instagram AI influencer claims are misleading
